title: UK must end all trade with Israel, says co-founder of BDS movement
summary_or_snippet: Exclusive: sanctions against ministers and settler groups are 'smoke and mirrors cop-out' says Omar Barghouti Britain's legal and ethical obligation to stop a genocide in Gaza requires it to take bigger steps than halting trade with illegal Israeli settlements or imposing further sanctions, Omar Barghouti, the co-founder of the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement has said.
